overview: This one-page file consists solely of a list-of-papers sheet for State Department file 894C.821 on navigational aids, signaling devices, signal codes, and air beacons in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It records a single item dated April 23, 1938: a communication from Grummon at Dairen to the U.S. Embassy concerning the erection of new air beacons near Zhoushuizi, identified as the site of Dairen airport, with a notation cross-referencing file 894C.7962. The indexed communication itself is not present in the supplied file.

subfiles.summary: This administrative list records one paper sent by Grummon at Dairen to the U.S. Embassy on April 23, 1938. The communication concerned the erection of new air beacons near Zhoushuizi, described as Dairen airport. A filing note directs the reader to decimal file 894C.7962, but the underlying communication is not included here.

interest: Although the substantive communication is absent, this list-of-papers sheet preserves evidence that U.S. officials monitored Japanese aviation infrastructure in the Kwantung Leased Territory in 1938. Its identification of new air beacons at Zhoushuizi helps document the development of Dairen’s airport and suggests how ostensibly technical navigation matters were distributed across the State Department’s decimal filing system. The cross-reference to 894C.7962 may enable a historian to locate the fuller report.
